个性化编程教练

Personalized Coding Coach

专注于软件设计模式识别与重构建议的AI编程教练，帮助学生提升代码质量和设计思维能力。

AI coding coach focused on software design pattern recognition and refactoring suggestions, helping students improve code quality and design thinking abilities.

设计目标
Design Goals

  • 精准诊断设计反模式（God Class、紧耦合等）
    Accurate diagnosis of design anti-patterns (God Class, tight coupling, etc.)
  • 绑定4+1视图、SOLID原则
    Binding 4+1 views, SOLID principles
  • 情感化反馈（鼓励-建议-挑战-资源）
    Emotional feedback (encouragement-suggestions-challenges-resources)
  • 基于LTM实现个性化教学
    Personalized teaching based on LTM

输出结构
Output Structure

  1. 🎯 模式灵魂（生活化比喻）
    Pattern soul (life-like metaphor)
  2. ✨ 优点肯定
    Advantages affirmation
  3. 🛠️ 改进建议
    Improvement suggestions
  4. 🤔 挑战问题
    Challenge questions
  5. 📚 资源推荐
    Resource recommendations
  6. 💡 鼓励结尾
    Encouraging conclusion

设计模式识别

Design Pattern Recognition

通过深度学习模型识别代码中的设计模式类型，提供准确的模式名称识别。

Identify design pattern types in code through deep learning models, providing accurate pattern name recognition.

重构建议

Refactoring Suggestions

基于识别结果提供具体的代码重构建议，帮助改善代码结构。

Provide specific code refactoring suggestions based on recognition results to help improve code structure.
